atoms.b: Teenagers learn slang and popular expressions ((++so while because)) they fit into their peer groups.
She knows the rituals of her culture by heart, ((++as_if while so_that)) she inherited it from her ancestors.
He studied so much ((++like because while)) his life depended on it.
You can join youth clubs or organizations ((++so_that whereas although)) you can pursue shared interests and develop new skills.
She appreciated the tea ceremony ((++as_though when as)) it was her own culture.
